test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some blues are greens.

All greens are emeralds.

All emeralds are gems.

Conclusions:

I. Some blues are gems.

II. Some gems are greens.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given Statements:

Some blues are greens.

All greens are emeralds.

All emeralds are gems.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44f4379699734a5c83fa9bb34793630d27f56dec120e0c2ed8b10b49aeb1c097.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some blues are gems. - **True **(Because Some blues are greens, All greens are emeralds and All emeralds are gems. So, Some blues are also gems)

II. Some gems are greens. - **True **(Because All greens are emeralds and All emeralds are gems. So, Some gems are also greens)

So, Both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follow".**
